# Eritrea

Values for an OG-Core calibration, then the estimates behind them. How to use them: [calibration guide](../calibration-guide.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −0.85, by age as below | DHS 2002, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −0.42 | DHS 2002, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | 2.97 − 0.432 × ln(GDP per capita, PPP) | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md), GDP per capita in constant 2021 international $; for example −0.31 at $2,000 and −1.01 at $10,000, each with a 95% prediction interval of about ±0.7 |
| `imm_pctiles` | not provided | — |

Divide each value by 100 × (1 − p) before passing it to OG-Core ([how](../calibration-guide.md#converting-a-gradient-to-og-cores-units)).

**`fert_gradient` by age of mother** ([how](../calibration-guide.md#fertility-by-age)):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.62 | −0.95 | −0.64 | −0.52 | −0.75 | −1.24 | −1.83 |

**`mort_gradient` by age** ([how](../calibration-guide.md#mortality-by-age)):

| 1–4 | 5–14 | 15–29 | 30–44 | 45–59 | 60–74 | 75+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −0.86 (DHS 2002) | value − 0.41 | value − 0.41 | value − 0.18 | value + 0.21 | the 45–59 value at 60, falling to 0 at 75 | 0 |

*Note:* The most recent survey with a wealth breakdown is from 2002. Gradients can change substantially over such a period; state the survey year when using these values.
